title: security(rbac): RBAC v2 KMS region-residency + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: tighten RBAC v2 policies to enforce KMS key region residency for customer-provided keys, improve audit logging for cross-region key access, and add guardrails to prevent misconfiguration in Private/Dedicated deployments. This PR adds enforcement and audit-only modes, upgrades residency checks in the KMS integration, surfaces violations in the admin console, and includes docs and e2e tests. Scope: 1) RBAC policy changes and admission checks to require kms_region when a resource is marked as resident. 2) KMS integration: residency validator and telemetry hooks. 3) Audit logging: emit structured audit events for region pin violations and KMS usage with sensitive fields redacted. 4) Docs and migration guide for customers on Dedicated/Private. Checklist: [x] policy design review (ENG-11234) [x] unit tests [x] e2e tests in perf-canary [x] docs and release notes [x] infra rollout plan for ops teams (canary + gradual enforcement) Related: Linear ENG-11234, SEC-4421. This is a high-impact security change; rollout will start in audit mode for 2 weeks before enforcement for opt-in accounts, then opt-out for new accounts, see migration guide.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) rbac: add kms_region label enforcement + admission hook (asha) 2) kms: add residency validator + telemetry hooks (asha) 3) docs: migration guide and console UI text (asha)
